status.main_product: Drone surveying, mapping, and industrial inspection services
status.scope_reason: The company directly offers commercial drone aerial surveying, 3D mapping, and photogrammetry services under its brand name across India.
status.evidence: Dronitech explicitly advertises and provides drone aerial land surveying, 3D mapping, and construction progress monitoring services from its headquarters in Mumbai on its official website.

claims.claim: The company reports providing aerial photogrammetry and drone land surveying services integrated with high-definition cameras, positioning systems, and RTK/PPK technology to achieve centimeter-level accuracy for land surveying, mapping, and construction monitoring.
The company reports offering drone surveying with LiDAR systems to produce elevation data and 3D geospatial models processed using specialized CAD and GIS-compatible mapping software.

The company reports offering an Aerial Intelligence Platform that serves as a toolset for visualizing, measuring, and storing spatial data, supporting orthophotography, digital surface models, and 3D terrain models.

The company reports utilizing sophisticated drone mapping software to process collected drone imagery, enabling the generation of 2D maps, 3D models, orthomosaics, digital elevation models, and contour mapping.
The company states that it integrates DGPS surveying and ground control points to deliver engineering-grade horizontal/vertical accuracy and detailed 3D models.
claims.note: The integration of DGPS surveying and ground control points to deliver engineering-grade horizontal/vertical accuracy and detailed 3D models could not be verified explicitly under the company's stated integration list.

claims.claim: The company reports providing drone-based aerial systems mapping services that integrate advanced sensors like thermal cameras, LiDAR technology, and AI-powered imaging systems for industrial monitoring and geospatial surveys.
claims.source: Dronitech Website (Industrial Robotics and Unmanned Systems Solutions Page)

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: Dronitech Aviation reports the internal development of proprietary software tools, including its proprietary "Droniview" software package, which is designed for drone management and flight data tracking.

claims.parameter: R&D and Innovation in Surveying Tech
claims.claim: The company reported that it was in the process of developing a prototype industrial Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) named "Droni" to support industrial missions.

The company completed 3D mapping and aerial photography for more than 50 level crossings for the Indian Railways across Maharashtra, reporting that the industrial surveys were completed within 7 to 8 days.
claims.source: Dronitech Website (Drones, A Key Tech Innovation In Construction Article)

claims.claim: The company's parent entity, Drovation Software Solutions Private Limited, reported an annual revenue bracket between ₹0 and ₹10 Crore for the financial year ending March 31, 2025.
claims.source: Tracxn Company Legal Entity Records for Drovation Software Solutions Private Limited

claims.claim: The company reports raising ₹3.5 crores ($500,000) in its initial seed funding round in October 2018 from Eagle Group and other angel investors.
The company reports a primary head office in Mumbai, Maharashtra, along with a partner office in Hyderabad, Telangana.

status.scope_reason: The company provides photogrammetry, mobile mapping, 3D laser scanning, and drone-based data processing/geospatial analytics services.
status.evidence: According to a regulatory filing reported by The Hindu in May 2025, Coffee Day Trading Ltd. proposed selling its 47.49% stake in Magnasoft Consulting India Private Limited to Innovic Management Services Private Ltd.

claims.claim: The company reports offering "MTerra", a geospatial platform alongside digital twins, topographic mapping, and specialized workflows like LiDAR classification, photogrammetry services, mobile mapping extractions, and UAV data processing.
claims.source: Magnasoft LinkedIn and Ordnance Survey Partner Directory listings for Magnasoft

claims.claim: The company maintains an Esri Partner Network Member status and employs a technical toolchain to execute enterprise-scale point cloud processing workflows, terrain modeling (DTM/DSM), 3D feature extraction, and automated methods.
claims.source: TechSagar Profile for Magnasoft Consulting India Private Limited

claims.claim: The company reports that it operates as a global technology venture delivering geospatial and digital twin solutions across 73 countries.
claims.source: GIM International and LinkedIn executive profile for Magnasoft leadership

claims.claim: Magnasoft Consulting India Private Limited operates as an official partner of Esri, collaborating to leverage geographic information system (GIS) software alongside its data processing workflows.
claims.source: Esri Partner Directory and TechSagar Profile for Magnasoft

claims.claim: The company maintains an active business partnership with Ordnance Survey in the United Kingdom to deliver high-precision mapping, digital twin engineering, and intelligent spatial solutions across national boundaries.
claims.source: Ordnance Survey Business Partner Finder profile for Magnasoft
